svg.aria-label: MIDI Control for Fireface: the Outputs lane

g.text: MIDIMATE eX Port 1 ⇄ MIDIMATE eX Port 1
Row 3 of the unit — the same in every submix. MUTE has no output leg on this unit (a measured null), so these strips carry none; Dim and Mute of
the two monitor pairs are faked on these faders.
Click the lane or a strip to read any 8
strips — the app plans BANK and
Out 1/2 on the output faders — this level
and those two strips are one fader. Dim
and Mute are faked there; moving it
Out 9/10 — the same mechanism on another
pair. No click at either end: the
hardware ramps, the app never does.
Plays the right leg of submix 27/28 — its
sends and pans are as reachable as any
Fed by AN 1, AN 2, Mic 7 · 3 unread
The output is always fixed at the level
stored in the flash — no MIDI message
The unit ramps, the app never does
Every value change glides at the unit's
own slew rate — about 37 ms for a full
mute — with no click at either end. The
app sends one value and lets the hardware
changed since the snapshot — not saved yet
the level Dim and Mute come back to
linked in the app — two writes, never the unit's gang
